findings.title: Moved and renamed functions no longer importable from mark_failed
findings.body:
This PR removes several names from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed`:
- `mark_failed_threshold`, now `try_incident_threshold` in `incidents.py`
- `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, now `create_incident_occurrence` in `incident_occurrence.py`
- `get_failure_reason`
- `get_monitor_environment_context`
- `SimpleCheckIn`

No other files are updated and no compatibility re-exports are left behind. Any existing caller, test import, or `mock.patch` target that references these names in `mark_failed` will now fail with `ImportError`/`AttributeError`. Examples are tests that import `get_failure_reason` or patch `mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence`.

Either update all references in the same PR or re-export the old names from `mark_failed`.

findings.title: Monitor context ignores the humanized config copy
findings.body:
`get_monitor_environment_context` builds `config`, a copy of the monitor config with `schedule_type` replaced by its display value. It then returns `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (the raw original) instead of that copy.

The local `config` is dead code, so the event's monitor context shows the raw integer `schedule_type` rather than the human-readable label. This bug existed before and was carried over unchanged by the move. Return `config` instead.
